purpose: controlled physical codec pilot; frozen before new calibration and held-out generation
tail_padding: repeat last action; valid length recorded; padded steps never executed
label_equality: all sampled official success/on/static/grasp labels exact
force_boundary: last physics substep sampled at 20 Hz; not integrated force or peak
readiness: at least one successful full replay-valid episode with grasp, release and sampled noncontact; codec accounting and identities valid on all recorded inputs
cost_reference: fast_joint_gripper calibration mean bytes per padded chunk
selection: minimum joint-limit-normalized arm MSE under calibration mean byte cap; ties by bytes then parameter tuple; no outcome labels
mechanism: copy unchanged 5x7 arm residual from original event window to matched noncontact window; gripper and all other actions original
rate_definition: actual binary episode packet bytes plus one 128-byte normalization record per method, divided by padded chunks; pretrained model assets reported separately
outcome_rule: official final success at the original planner-completion horizon; identical lengths, no settling or first-success stopping
unavailable_variants: retain unavailable/invalid counts and report observed success only on common verified originals, never impute physical failure
